baselines.limitation: The official UNBench prior uses adopted-resolution voting data; these reconstruction items concern rejected drafts. This is a distribution-shift comparator, not a matched task population.

limits: Two exposed events are not seven independent experiments; no significance or calibration-bin claim.
Historical reconstruction, not prospective forecasting; archived-version availability remains unresolved.
The single added correct action is an exact Y/N first-token logit tie under BF16 greedy decoding.
No new training and no evidence of fine-tuning or deliberation gain.
Policy observations are assistant source checks; rubric calibration and independent ratings remain pending.
Only decoder instrumentation changed after a failed first attempt; cases, references and prompts remained frozen.
